nom: BYOMA Blemish Relief Soothing Mist Facial Toner

segments.sensitive: Sensitive skin is the most frequently named skin type; reviewers describe it as calming and non-irritating, including for eczema, perioral dermatitis, and reactive skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one in a hot dry climate, report it hydrates and relieves tightness, with several naming it a rehydrating step in their routine.
segments.oily: One reviewer cautions that if skin is oily, no other moisture product should be layered on top, since the mist already leaves a film on the skin.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes her skin as normal and still finds it well suited to sensitive skin too.

concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several with rosacea, report visibly calmer, less red-looking skin after use; a smaller group says they saw little to no change in their redness despite continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers describe it as part of a blemish-prone routine that helps keep breakouts and acne in check, though results are described more as maintenance than a cure.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the mist as hydrating, with several using it as a mid-day refresh for skin that feels dry or tight.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers frame it as supportive of the skin barrier, describing it as calming for compromised or irritated skin.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers with oily or greasy skin report it helps without adding extra shine, though one warns against layering more moisture on top if skin is already oily.

aspects.libelle: Light chamomile scent bothers some fragrance-sensitive users
Can leave a sticky or greasy-feeling residue
Large bottle size for the price

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Product request to shake well before use. With cap tight and shaking I open the lid and there is liquid in the cap and dripping down. Don't even think about shaking with lid off. Product itself is scent less which I appreciate. I did think it left a slightly sticky residue on my face. Pass

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this product for almost three weeks now and while I enjoy how easy it is to apply and the mist to my face it, doesn't really do anything for my redness. I've suffered from a red skin face most of my adult life and I was hoping this would help calm it down some. It does help with my dry skin. It isn't sticky when applying. I really like the texture and consistency. I live in the south where we have very dry, hot weather so this does bring relief to my face. I will continue using and hope after time I may see more benefits.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been enjoying this mist post-shower and outdoor swim. I find that it helps cool down my face and adds a layer of moisture that you just don't usually achieve with cream/lotion alone. I have rosacea so I have tested to see if it reduces any redness or inflammation and I have noted a difference. Nothing jaw-dropping, but honestly anything that can offer rosacea relief is worth it, in my opinion. The mist is very fine, which makes application really pleasant. I hate whenever a spray either doesn't come out at all, or comes out in massive globules that make even application difficult. This spray is the exact opposite. Very easy to get even distribution of the product and the mist is so fine that it doesn't overload my face with product that I then have to spread around. It does dry down a bit sticky, so if that bothers you it might not be your top choice. Overall I'm happy with it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this stuff! It feels so good, very soothing during the day. I honestly use it probably way more than I should but I have extremely dry skin and this spray actually helps that! It doesn't really have a smell, which is probably good for your skin. Some people have told me it makes their skin greasy, however that was not my experience at all. If you have very dry, flaky skin this is a must try. Also...if you're a skin picker (I am unfortunately) this takes redness away IMMEDIATELY!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This has been such a beautiful soothing toner for my skin. I have rosacea and I constantly deal with redness on my cheeks and burning. This toner is so soothing for flare ups and just everyday pollution. I love how light the texture is and how easily my skin drinks it up. I have really loved adding it to my routine!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have mild redness and acne on my face and it's such a challenge to find a product that actually calms it down. I spray this on after cleansing my skin and my skin feels so refreshed and looks much more calm. I love that it comes out as a fine mist and hits all of my face in 1-2 spritzes.

extraits.texte: I've been really enjoying this toner. It feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave behind any sticky residue. My skin feels hydrated and calmer after using it, and I noticed that temporary redness looks less noticeable with consistent use. It layers well with the rest of my skincare and hasn't irritated my dry, sensitive skin. While it isn't an overnight fix for redness, it's a soothing toner that helps support my skin barrier and is a great value for the price.
